concerns.location: plan.md: 'Time Budget & Feasibility (2‑core CPU runner)' table
concerns.text: The plan's own throughput assumption contradicts its time budget. It states '~10–20 ns/day/core‑pair for small boxes' and then claims 27 production runs totalling 144 ns (9×1 + 9×5 + 9×10 ns) complete in '≈3.5–4.5 h'. At 10 ns/day, a single 10 ns run takes ~24 h; nine of them alone exceed 9 days, not 4.5 h. Even at 20 ns/day the 10 ns block needs ~108 h. The plan cannot run on the free 2-core / 6 h GitHub Actions runner as written; either the throughput estimate or the run matrix (durations × seeds × solvents) must be revised (e.g. fewer seeds at 10 ns, smaller boxes, or splitting across jobs with checkpoint/restart).

contracts/sensitivity_report.schema.yaml is committed and referenced in the project tree, but no phase in the Requirement Coverage table produces data/processed/sensitivity_report.json, and the plan's data flow (data-model.md) never mentions it. Either remove the orphaned contract or add the producing step; as written the data model promises an artifact nothing generates.
